common_assumptions.forecast_period_convention: Five annual rolling years after research reference. Q2 annualized revenue is a scenario seed, not seasonally adjusted issuer forecast. Model assumes no additional M&A, no new financing, and no value for future option subscription cash.
common_assumptions.payout_convention: 50% annual modeled owner cash and treasury interest as cash-equivalent distributions. Issuer policy is 50% cumulative adjusted FCF over rolling five years, not annual guaranteed dividends. No buyback entitlement credited to new buyer.
common_assumptions.cash_cost_convention: EBITDA includes future compensation and credit-loss costs with no addback. Future lease cash and all modeled capex are deducted. Existing options diluted without proceeds is a conservative sensitivity. Existing unfunded gratuity reserved once in opening equity cash, future service compensation remains an operating expense.
